settings.title: Kandil Settings
general.languageNote: Kandil's interface has been updated. Restart Kandil so that KRunner results use the new language as well.
general.shortcutNote: The key combination that opens and closes Kandil.
general.shortcutFailed: The shortcut could not be assigned. Another application may already be using it.
general.searchPluginsNote: Kandil uses KRunner's plugins. They are enabled, disabled and ordered in System Settings.
appearance.heroCard: Show calculations in a large card
animation.note: A duration of 0 turns resize animations off.
prefixes.note: Type a prefix followed by a space to search only in that mode. Prefixes do not depend on the interface language.
prefixes.helpKeyNote: Typed on its own, it opens the help list.
prefixes.label: Name
prefixes.duplicate: This prefix is also used by another mode
engines.note: Type a keyword followed by a space and the search terms, for example “gg ubuntu”. %s in the address is replaced with the search terms.
engines.name: Name
engines.url: Search address (%s is replaced with the search terms)
engines.duplicate: This keyword is also used by a prefix or another search engine
engines.noPlaceholder: The address does not contain %s; the search terms are added at the end
aiset.note: Connect a local model (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp) or an online service. Type the keyword, a space and your question, for example “ai what is KDE?”.
aiset.keyNone: Not set (not needed for local models)
aiset.modelAuto: If empty, the first model offered by the server is used
aiset.systemPromptDefault: Default: short answers in the language of the question
aiset.keysNote: API keys are not stored in the settings file but in ~/.config/kandil/secrets.json, which only you can read.
command.terminalNote: Used with Ctrl+Enter. The shell and the command are appended to it.
about.description: A fast launcher built on KRunner's search engine. All KRunner plugins and their settings work as they are.
guide.title: Usage
guide.general.intro: Open Kandil with its global shortcut, type and press Enter. Type %1 in an empty search field to see all prefixes and keys.
guide.browse.intro: Type %1 and a space. With nothing typed, places and drives are listed; a name finds folders; a path such as ~/Documents/ lists that folder, and the text after the last / filters it.
guide.browse.enter: Enter the folder, or open the file in its default application
guide.browse.fm: Open the folder, or show the file, in the file manager
guide.browse.terminal: Open a terminal in the folder
guide.emoji.intro: Type %1, a space and a name or keyword. With nothing typed, recently used emoji and all categories are listed. The skin tone is set on the Behavior page.
guide.emoji.copy: Copy the emoji to the clipboard
guide.emoji.name: Copy the emoji's name
guide.clip.intro: Type %1, a space and part of a copied text to search the clipboard history.
guide.clip.copy: Copy the item to the clipboard again
guide.calc.intro: Type %1, a space and an expression, for example “sqrt(2)”; Enter copies the result. Unit conversions such as “10 km > mi” work in the normal search without a prefix.
guide.web.intro: Type %1, a space and your query to list Brave Search results. An address such as kde.org opens directly in the normal search, without a prefix.
guide.web.open: Open the selected result in the browser; the last row opens the full results page
guide.engine.open: Open the search on the site; with an empty query, the site's home page
guide.ai.intro: Type a provider's keyword (for example “%1”), a space and your question. The answer appears in the panel, and the next question continues the same conversation.
guide.cmd.intro: Type %1, a space and a shell command. The command runs only when you press Enter and is stopped after the timeout set above.
guide.cmd.run: Run the command and show its output
guide.cmd.terminal: Run the command in a terminal
